text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming on sections of Donino Avenue and Brookfield Road in the Hoggs Hollow neighbourhood. This was in order to address residents' concerns with the speed of traffic on these two streets. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the traffic calming policy has been satisfied on both streets. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on the subject sections of these streets, subject to positive results of the traffic calming polls.

North York Community Council: 1. Directed City Clerks to poll eligible householders on Donino Avenue, between Mill Street/Brookfield Road and Donino Court, to determine whether residents support the installation of traffic calming, in accordance with the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the poll, directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Donino Avenue, between Mill Street/Brookfield Road and Donino Court, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown in the speed hump plan that Transportation Services circulates to residents during the polling process. 3.
